dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hmm... Multiple scents, all mingled together... Looks like many people have used this place as a rest stop.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hmm? ...There's a floral scent, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Ah yes, that would be the plant-based essential oil I just applied. What do you think? Wanna check out my freshly groomed tail?
